dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: The enemies are pretty tough, right? So you'd probably be better off taking some of your stronger friends...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Uhh... No, I'm not being lazy, it's just... my ninjutsu isn't really meant for fighting...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Lemme sleep a bit more, just until I get a little bit taller, and then I'm sure I can... Zzz...
